description: This file defines the CleanUpInstallAPI class, which implements a REST API endpoint for cleaning up after installation procedures in the OrangeHRM system. It handles POST requests to perform database cleanup or removal based on the installation state.

classes.name: CleanUpInstallAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for cleaning up the installation environment, extending from AbstractInstallerRestController.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to perform cleanup operations depending on whether the database is new or an installation failure.
